40022123.author: पदार्थः
40022123.content: एवं thus, उक्तः spoken, तु but, रामेण by Rama, परां great, व्रीडां shame, उपागमत् he attained, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valor, मन्दं slowly, मन्दं slowly, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022123.author: Translation
40022123.content: Thus addressed by Rama, the valiant Shatrughna felt extreme embarrassment and spoke very slowly.

40022124.author: पदार्थः
40022124.content: अधर्मं unrighteousness, विद्म I know, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, हि indeed, अस्मिन् in this, अर्थे matter, नरेश्वर O lord of men, कथं how, तिष्ठत्सु while being present, ज्येष्ठेषु the elders, कनीयान् a younger one, अभिषिच्यते is consecrated.

40022124.author: Translation
40022124.content: O Kakutstha, O king, I indeed know that this matter is unrighteous; how can a younger brother be consecrated while his elders are present?

40022125.author: पदार्थः
40022125.content: अवश्यं certainly, करणीयं to be done, च and, शासनं command, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, तव your, च and, एव indeed, महाभाग O illustrious one, शासनं command, दुरतिक्रमम् inviolable.

40022125.author: Translation
40022125.content: O best among men and illustrious one, your command is certainly to be carried out and is indeed inviolable.

40022126.author: पदार्थः
40022126.content: त्वत्तो from you, मया by me, श्रुतं heard, वीर O hero, श्रुतिभ्यः from the scriptures, च and, मया by me, श्रुतम् heard, न not, उत्तरं a reply, हि indeed, मया by me, वाच्यं to be spoken, मध्यमे when the middle one (Bharata), प्रतिजानति promises.

40022126.author: Translation
40022126.content: O hero, I have heard from you and from the scriptures that when the middle brother undertakes a task, no reply should indeed be given by me.

40022127.author: पदार्थः
40022127.content: व्याहृतं spoken, दुर्वचो harsh words, घोरं terrible, हन्तास्मि I will kill, लवणं Lavana, मृधे in battle, तस्य of that, एवं thus, मे my, दुरुक्तस्य ill-spoken word, दुर्गतिः misfortune, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.

40022127.author: Translation
40022127.content: O best among men, I have uttered terrible, harsh words, saying "I will kill Lavana in battle," and such an ill-spoken word of mine will lead to misfortune.

40022128.author: पदार्थः
40022128.content: उत्तरं a reply, न not, हि indeed, वक्तव्यं to be spoken, ज्येष्ठेन by the elder brother, अभिहिते when commanded, पुनः again, अधर्मसहितं unrighteous, च and, एव indeed, परलोकविवर्जितम् devoid of the other world.

40022128.author: Translation
40022128.content: Indeed, a reply should not be spoken again when commanded by the elder brother, as doing so is unrighteous and leads to no good in the afterlife.

40022129.author: पदार्थः
40022129.content: सः that, अहं I, द्वितीयं a second, काकुत्स्थ O scion of Kakutstha, न not, वक्ष्यामि I will speak, तव your, उत्तरम् a reply, मा let not, द्वितीयेन by a second (word/action), दण्डो punishment, वै indeed, निपतेत् fall, मयि upon me, मानद O giver of honor.

40022129.author: Translation
40022129.content: Therefore, O scion of Kakutstha, I will not speak a second reply to you, lest a second punishment indeed fall upon me, O giver of honor.

40022130.author: पदार्थः
40022130.content: कामकारो one who acts according to his own will, हि indeed, अहं I, राजन् O King, तव your, अस्मि am, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, अधर्मं unrighteousness, जहि destroy, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, मत्कृते for my sake, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022130.author: Translation
40022130.content: Shatrughna tells Rama that he is at Rama's disposal and implores him to destroy this unrighteousness for his sake.

40022131.author: पदार्थः
40022131.content: एवम् thus, उक्ते having been spoken, तु then, शूरेण by the brave one, शत्रुघ्नेन by Shatrughna, महात्मना by the great-souled one, उवाच spoke, रामः Rama, संहृष्टो greatly delighted, भरतं to Bharata, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, तथा and.

40022131.author: Translation
40022131.content: When the brave and great-souled Shatrughna had thus spoken, Rama, greatly delighted, addressed Bharata and Lakshmana.

40022132.author: पदार्थः
40022132.content: सम्भारान् preparations, अभिषेकस्य for the consecration, आनयध्वं bring, समाहिताः attentively, अद्यैव today itself, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् the tiger among men, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall consecrate, राघवम् the descendant of Raghu.

40022132.author: Translation
40022132.content: Rama commanded them to carefully bring the materials for the consecration, declaring that he would anoint Bharata, the tiger among men and descendant of Raghu, today itself.

40022133.author: पदार्थः
40022133.content: पुरोहितं the chief priest, च and, काकुत्स्थं O Kakutstha, नैगमान् the citizens, ऋत्विजः the priests, तथा and, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, चैव and also, तान् them, सर्वान् all, आनयध्वं bring, ममाज्ञया by my command.

40022133.author: Translation
40022133.content: Rama further instructed them to bring the chief priest, the citizens, the ritual priests, and all the ministers by his command.

40022134.author: पदार्थः
40022134.content: राज्ञः of the king, शासनम् the command, आज्ञाय having understood, तथा thus, अकुर्वन् they did, महारथाः the great charioteers, अभिषेकसमारम्भं the commencement of the consecration, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, पुरोधसम् the chief priest, प्रविष्टा entered, राजभवनं the royal palace, राजानो the kings, ब्राह्मणाः the Brahmins, तथा and.

40022134.author: Translation
40022134.content: Having understood the king's command, the great charioteers (Bharata and Lakshmana) acted accordingly, and then the kings and Brahmins, honoring the chief priest, entered the royal palace for the commencement of the consecration.

40022135.author: पदार्थः
40022135.content: तथो then, अभिषेको the anointing, ववृधे flourished, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, सम्प्रहर्षकरः causing great joy, श्रीमान् glorious, राघवस्य of Rama, पुरस्य of the city, च and.

40022135.author: Translation
40022135.content: Then, the glorious anointing of the great-souled Shatrughna, which brought immense joy to Rama and the entire city, flourished.

40022136.author: पदार्थः
40022136.content: अभिषिक्तस्तु but having been consecrated, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, बभौ shone, च and, आदित्यसन्निभः sun-like, अभिषिक्तः consecrated, पुरा formerly, स्कन्दः Skanda, सेन्द्रैरिव as if with Indra, मरुद्गणैः by the Marut hosts.

40022136.author: Translation
40022136.content: Having been consecrated, Shatrughna shone like the sun, just as Skanda had shone in ancient times when consecrated by Indra and the Marut hosts.

40022137.author: पदार्थः
40022137.content: अभिषिक्ते when consecrated, तु indeed, शत्रुघ्ने Shatrughna, रामेणा by Rama, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा by the one of unwearied deeds, पौराः the citizens, प्रमुदिताश्च and delighted, आसन् were, ब्राह्मणाश्च and the Brahmins, बहुश्रुताः learned.

40022137.author: Translation
40022137.content: When Shatrughna was consecrated by Rama, whose deeds were effortless, the citizens and the highly learned Brahmins were greatly delighted.

40022138.author: पदार्थः
40022138.content: कौसल्या Kausalya, च and, सुमित्रा Sumitra, च and, मङ्गलम् auspicious rites, केकयी Kaikeyi, तथा likewise, चक्रुस्ता they performed, राजभवने in the royal palace, याश्च and those, अन्या other, राजयोषितः royal ladies.

40022138.author: Translation
40022138.content: Kausalya, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi, along with other royal ladies, performed auspicious rites in the royal palace.

40022139.author: पदार्थः
40022139.content: ऋषयश्च and the sages, महात्मानो great-souled, यमुनातीरवासिनः dwelling on the banks of Yamuna, हतम् slain, लवणम् Lavana, आशंसुः they predicted, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, अभिषेचनात् from the consecration.

40022139.author: Translation
40022139.content: The great-souled sages dwelling on the banks of the Yamuna predicted that Lavana would be slain as a result of Shatrughna's consecration.

40022140.author: पदार्थः
40022140.content: ततः then, अभिषिक्तम् consecrated, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, अङ्कम् lap, आरोप्य having placed, राघवः Rama, उवाच spoke, मधुराम् sweet, वाणीम् words, तेजः splendor, तस्य his, अभिपूरयन् enhancing.

40022140.author: Translation
40022140.content: Then, Rama, having placed the consecrated Shatrughna on his lap, spoke sweet words, thereby enhancing his splendor and might.

40022141.author: पदार्थः
40022141.content: अयम् this, शरः arrow, तु indeed, अमोघः unfailing, ते your, दिव्यः divine, परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of enemy cities, अनेन by this, लवणम् Lavana, सौम्य O gentle one, हन्ता असि you will kill, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022141.author: Translation
40022141.content: O gentle Shatrughna, this divine arrow of yours is unfailing and capable of conquering enemy cities; with this, you will surely kill Lavana.

40022142.author: पदार्थः
40022142.content: सृष्टः created, शरः arrow, अयम् this, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, यदा when, शेते rests, महार्णवे in the great ocean.

40022142.author: Translation
40022142.content: O Kakutstha, this arrow was created when (Vishnu) rested in the great cosmic ocean.

40022143.author: पदार्थः
40022143.content: स्वयम्भूः the self-born, अजितः unconquered, देवः god, यत् which, न not, अपश्यन् saw, सुरासुराः gods and demons, अदृश्यः invisible, सर्वभूतानाम् to all beings, तेन therefore, अयम् this, तु indeed, शरोत्तमः the best of arrows.

40022143.author: Translation
40022143.content: This arrow is indeed the best of arrows because it was created by the self-born, unconquered God (Vishnu) in a form that was invisible to all gods, demons, and other beings.

40022144.author: पदार्थः
40022144.content: सृष्टः created, क्रोधाभिभूतेन by one overcome by anger, विनाशार्थम् for the destruction, दुरात्मनोः of the two wicked ones, मधुकैटभयोः Madhu and Kaitabha, वीर O hero, विघाते in obstructing, वर्तमानयोः who were engaged, स्रष्टुकामेन by the one desirous of creating, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, तौ those two, च and, अनेन by this, हतौ were killed, युधि in battle.

40022144.author: Translation
40022144.content: O hero, this arrow was created by the angry (Vishnu) for the destruction of the two wicked demons, Madhu and Kaitabha, who were obstructing the creation of the three worlds, and indeed, those two were killed in battle by this very arrow.

40022145.author: पदार्थः
40022145.content: तौ those two, हत्वा having killed, जनभोगार्थं for the enjoyment of people, कैटभं Kaitabha, तु indeed, मधुं Madhu, तथा and, अनेन by this, शरमुख्येन excellent arrow, ततो then, लोकांश्चकार created the worlds, सः he.

40022145.author: Translation
40022145.content: Having killed Kaitabha and Madhu for the benefit of mankind, he (Vishnu) then created the worlds with this excellent arrow.

40022146.author: पदार्थः
40022146.content: न not, अयं this, मया by me, शरः arrow, पूर्वं previously, रावणस्य of Ravana, वधार्थिना by one desiring the death, मुक्तः released, शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, भूतानां of beings, महांस्त्रासः great terror, भवेत् would occur, इति thinking thus.

40022146.author: Translation
40022146.content: O Shatrughna, I did not release this arrow previously, even when desiring Ravana's death, thinking that it would cause great terror to all beings.

40022147.author: पदार्थः
40022147.content: यत् च and which, तस्य his, महच्छूलं great trident, त्र्यम्बकेण by Tryambaka (Shiva), महात्मना by the great-souled one, दत्तं given, शत्रुविनाशाय for the destruction of enemies, मधोः Madhu's, आयुधं weapon, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022147.author: Translation
40022147.content: And that great trident, Madhu's excellent weapon, was given to him by the great-souled Tryambaka (Shiva) for the destruction of enemies.

40022148.author: पदार्थः
40022148.content: सः he, तं that, निक्षिप्य having placed, भवने in his dwelling, पूज्यमानः being worshipped, पुनः पुनः again and again, दिशः directions, सर्वाः all, समासाद्य having traversed, प्राप्नोति obtains, आहारम् food, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022148.author: Translation
40022148.content: Having placed that (trident) in his dwelling, and being worshipped repeatedly, he (Madhu) would traverse all directions and obtain excellent food.

40022149.author: पदार्थः
40022149.content: यदा when, तु but, युद्धम् battle, आकाङ्क्षन् desiring, कश्चित् someone, एनं him, समाह्वयेत् challenges, तदा then, शूलं the trident, गहीत्वा having taken, तं him, भस्म to ashes, रक्षः the demon, करोति makes, हि indeed.

40022149.author: Translation
40022149.content: But when someone desiring battle would challenge him, the demon (Madhu) would then take the trident and indeed reduce that challenger to ashes.

40022150.author: पदार्थः
40022150.content: स one who, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O best among men, तम् him, आयुधविनाकृतम् deprived of weapons, अप्रविष्टम् not having entered, पुरम् the city, पूर्वम् previously, द्वारि at the gate, तिष्ठ stand, धृतायुधः holding weapons.

40022150.author: Translation
40022150.content: O best among men, you should stand at the city gate, armed, and wait for him, who is deprived of weapons and has not yet entered the city.

40022151.author: पदार्थः
40022151.content: अप्रविष्टम् not having entered, च and, भवनम् the dwelling, युद्धाय for battle, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, आह्वयेथाः you should challenge, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, ततः then, हन्तासि you will kill, राक्षसम् the demon.

40022151.author: Translation
40022151.content: O best among men, O mighty-armed one, you should challenge him for battle before he enters his dwelling, and then you will be able to kill the demon.

40022152.author: पदार्थः
40022152.content: अन्यथा otherwise, क्रियमाणे if done, तु indeed, अवध्यः unkillable, सः he, भविष्यति will become, यदि if, तु indeed, एवम् thus, कृते done, वीर O hero, विनाशम् destruction, उपयास्यति he will attain.

40022152.author: Translation
40022152.content: If this is done otherwise, he will become unkillable, but if you act in this manner, O hero, he will certainly meet his destruction.

40022153.author: पदार्थः
40022153.content: एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been told, शूलस्य of the spear, च and, विपर्ययः the reversal, श्रीमतः glorious, शितिकण्ठस्य of the blue-throated one (Shiva), कृत्यम् the deed, हि indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् difficult to transgress.

40022153.author: Translation
40022153.content: All this has been explained to you, including the reversal of the spear's power, for the deed of the glorious blue-throated Shiva is indeed impossible to transgress. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 63 ।। Thus ends the sixty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
